_why: One name check guards a release's version and service name at both doors (F28 FR9, design 'One name check at both doors'). The deploy webhook refuses a name that fails it; the worker folds such a version into `__other__`. Go cannot import Python, so the two implementations agree only if both read these cases: apps/workers/internal/pipeline/derive reads them now, and the webhook's Python check reads them when it is built (F28 plan T2.2).
_rule: A name fails when it holds a control character (Unicode category Cc: C0, DEL and C1, so NUL too), a bidirectional embedding, override or isolate (U+202A to U+202E, U+2066 to U+2069), or a Unicode tag character (U+E0000 to U+E007F), or when it is exactly the reserved `__other__`. Length is not part of this rule: each door applies its own limit. The empty string passes: it is a span with no version.

cases.name: a name merely containing the reserved word
